card.title: Fartastic Adventures by Momma Bear Audio

metadata.description: 'Fartastic Adventures' is a hilarious and educational audio series hosted by Ms. Rylee. Delve into the science behind farts, discover fascinating facts, and enjoy fun fart sounds. Explore famous farts from history, learn 'Fart Facts,' and discuss foods that affect flatulence. It's a lighthearted journey celebrating the natural side of being human, where laughter meets learning. Join us for a toot-ally unique adventure!
